checkbox

Multi-select item.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
value String No Identifier of the checkbox. When a check box is selected, the change event of the checkbox-group is triggered carrying the value attribute of the checkbox.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
checked Boolean false No Whether the current check box is selected. It can be used to set the default selection.
color String #09BB07 No Color of the checkbox, which is the same as the CSS color.

Sample Code


<checkbox-group bindchange='checkboxChange'>
  <label ma:for='{{items}}' ma:key='{{item.value}}'>
    <view>
      <checkbox value='{{item.value}}' checked='{{item.checked}}' color='pink' />
    </view>
    <view>{{item.name}}</view>
  </label>
</checkbox-group>

Page({
  data: {
    items: [
      { value: 'USA', name: 'USA' },
      { value: 'CHN', name: 'China', checked: 'true' },
      { value: 'BRA', name: 'Brazil' },
      { value: 'JPN', name: 'Japan' },
      { value: 'ENG', name: 'England' },
      { value: 'FRA', name: 'France' }
    ]
  },
  checkboxChange: function(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.value)
    var items = this.data.items,
      values = e.detail.value
    for (var i = 0, lenI = items.length; i < lenI; ++i) {
      items[i].checked = false

      for (var j = 0, lenJ = values.length; j < lenJ; ++j) {
        if (items[i].value === values[j]) {
          items[i].checked = true
          break
        }
      }
    }

    this.setData({
      items: items
    })
  }
})
